title: Rescue Operation
dateline: A rooftop over the storm-dark city.
mood: A beep on a rooftop and a beep in the courtyard. Guinevere runs, and Fanny has to decide who leads.

hero.alt: Students watch a big screen showing a ragged star-shaped rift, and a small winged figure flying straight at it.
hero.credit: Official interactive drama: Guinevere and Vexana

segs.t: The Citadel’s storm had turned midmorning to dusk. Vexana stood on the roof of a lecture block, staff in hand, the Enders crouched around her. Across the courtyard rose the Academy hall, and above it the ragged wound in the sky.

Behind her, folded against a chimney stack, her suit waited with its eyes dark. Purple plate edged in gold. A heart-shaped crest on its chest. She had called it through a portal at dawn. The Enders paid it no mind.
The Will’s voice had said one thing. “The Academy. Strike.”
She could have struck from the far ridge, ten times past the beep. She had taken the nearest roof.
One look,
she had told herself.

media.alt: A dark figure with a glowing staff stands at the edge of a rooftop, wind rushing past.
media.credit: Official comic: Guinevere and Vexana, page 43

segs.t: At her wrist, inside the sleeve, the Emblem beeped.
It was small and bright, and it carried over the sirens. Across the courtyard, a second beep answered.
Down there Guinevere stood with the frontline, one hand at her collar. She was crying. She was smiling, too, a little.
“Betray her...” Vexana said, very low.
“But to protect her...”

media.alt: Vexana, her hair gone pale, looks down with tired eyes: Betray her...
media.credit: Official comic: Guinevere and Vexana, page 44

media.alt: Vexana stands with her staff before her towering purple and gold suit, a heart-shaped crest on its chest: But to protect her...
media.credit: Official comic: Guinevere and Vexana, page 44

segs.t: “Even hidden in the dark of night, I will remain an unwavering guardian.”

Guinevere would follow that beep anywhere. At the hall the whole team stood at Guinevere’s back. When the Singularity, the Enders’ gateway, opened wide, the Matrix would take them all. Out on the platforms, alone, Vexana could drive her off first.
She stepped to the roof’s edge, so the rift’s glow over the bay lit her from behind. A shape, and nothing more. Let her be seen. Let her be followed.
She jumped for the platforms, the broad stone tiers that joined the city’s wards above the bay. The Enders poured after her.

Fanny stood in the courtyard under a sky the color of slate. The frontline was forming: Shield soldiers, students in suits, Layla at her left with the cannon on her shoulder. Enders crawled along the roofs.
A small bright beep cut through the sirens.
It came from Guinevere’s collar. She pressed her hand over the gold star there, and her face crumpled.

media.alt: Guinevere, tears in her eyes, presses her hand over the gold star at her collar.
media.credit: Official comic: Guinevere and Vexana, page 45

segs.t: “Guinevere?”
Guinevere was looking at a roof across the courtyard. A figure stood on its edge against the glow, a staff in its hand, too dark to read.
“That’s her,” she whispered. “That’s her.”
The figure jumped. Guinevere’s wings of light opened, and she shot after it.
“Guinevere!”
She did not turn. She had left her post without an order. Fanny had never once done that, and had never once wanted to.

Fanny looked up, for anything that could see farther than she could. On the bell tower a girl sat with her boots over the edge and a lollipop in her cheek. Selena. A dragon-shaped machine crouched beside her. Neither moved.
Mobile support.
A spotter takes the best seat in the city and sits still until she sees something.
Good. I should tell the commanders she’s in place.
“Fanny!” Layla had her by the sleeve. “The hall. Now!”
In the hall, students packed the dark under the big display. It showed the Singularity, a ragged magenta wound, and a small figure flying straight at it. Then Guinevere’s face filled the screen.
“I’m prepared to enter the Singularity.”

blocks.caption: I’m prepared to enter the Singularity.

segs.t: The map went red.

media.alt: On the big screen a map of the city glows red, a warning sign flashes, and red zones spread across it.
media.credit: Official interactive drama: Guinevere and Vexana

segs.t: Angela stood at the panel with Tetra at her shoulder. “According to the readings, the Singularity’s energy signature is spiking rapidly. The Enders are mobilizing. What is our course of action?”

blocks.caption: According to the readings, the Singularity’s energy signature is spiking rapidly. The Enders are mobilizing. What is our course of action?

segs.t: “So many hostiles! She must be in danger!” Fanny’s voice was already the command voice. “Shield squad holds the courtyard. Angela, with me. Layla, take the...”

blocks.caption: So many hostiles! She must be in danger!

segs.t: “I’ve already identified several weak points in their defenses.” Layla held up her tablet. The red map was marked with green. “This rescue operation is ready to go!”

blocks.caption: I’ve already identified several weak points in their defenses. This rescue operation is ready to go!

media.alt: Fanny, Layla and Angela stand together, Layla in the middle with a hand on her chest, ready to go.
media.credit: Official interactive drama: Guinevere and Vexana

segs.t: Fanny looked at the marks.
Hold the line and send a squad. That is the Shield’s way.
It was slower than Layla’s, by a lot. Layla had built that map in the time it took Fanny to give one order.
“Rear support goes with them,” said Chang’e’s voice on the channel. “They need Angela’s shield more than I do.”
“Your sector, Commander,” said Ruby.
“Go,” said Lesley. “I have the rear line.”
Ruby came through the hall at a run, the scythe on her shoulder. At the gate portal Layla stepped forward, as she always did. Fanny’s hand rose to the back of Layla’s collar, as it always did.
She lowered it.
“Lead,” she said.
